parameters.initialMessages:
Welcome to Persona — your personalised tech-news aggregator.
Type `help` to see all commands, or `register <email> <password>` to begin.

parameters.text:
=You are scoring one news article for one user.

User interests: {{ $json.interests.join(', ') }}
Article title: {{ $json.title }}
Article snippet: {{ $json.snippet }}

Score relevance using this scale only:
0 = unrelated
1-3 = weak match
4-6 = relevant
7-8 = strong match
9-10 = excellent match

Rules:
- Return only valid JSON.
- score must be a whole integer.
- score must be between 0 and 10.
- reason must be under 12 words.

Return exactly:
{"score":0,"reason":"short reason"}
